title: 50agents vs Zapier: compared row by row | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Zapier: Zapier connects 10,541+ apps with code steps; 50agents builds automations, AI agents and apps from plain words. Free to start.
answer: Pick Zapier for 10,541+ apps, code steps and admin controls such as SCIM.
Pick 50agents to describe the job in plain words and have Captain build it.
ask: Set up an automation: every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet and posted in a Slack channel
lede: The main differences, one row at a time.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

strengths.title: Websites with no app
strengths.line: A browser agent reads sites on a schedule and leaves you a report.

move.title: Start with one Zap
move.body: Pick one that runs often and write what it does as a sentence.

move.title: Give that sentence to Captain
move.body: Captain asks which sheet and channel, then shows the plan.

move.title: Run both for a week
move.body: Compare the rows and messages, then turn the Zap off.

faqs.q: Does 50agents connect to the same apps as Zapier?
faqs.a: Many of them. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket; Zapier lists 10,541+. Check your apps first.

faqs.q: Can I import my Zaps into 50agents?
faqs.a: No. Describe each Zap to Captain instead; it rebuilds it and shows the plan before it goes live.
No. Steps are fixed blocks. Zapier has JavaScript and Python steps.
